recommended_order: A/B current output heads + surface loss
only then test larger adaptation if the A/B diagnoses under-capacity

A_current_output_head_tuning.solves: low-cost global correction of pose/camera/shape outputs
A_current_output_head_tuning.current_evidence: V2 changes 2D joint validation modestly; no surface evidence
A_current_output_head_tuning.required_supervision: independent train/validation surface observations plus joint regression metric
A_current_output_head_tuning.risk: camera and pose can absorb 2D loss without improving 3D surface
A_current_output_head_tuning.minimum_ab: same official initialization and joint loss; B adds only surface loss
A_current_output_head_tuning.execute_when: after subject-disjoint surface train/validation data exist

B_output_head_plus_limited_body_decoder.solves: more capacity for target-domain image-to-body mapping
B_output_head_plus_limited_body_decoder.current_evidence: not supported yet; current failure could be supervision rather than capacity
B_output_head_plus_limited_body_decoder.required_supervision: larger diverse surface dataset with held-out subjects
B_output_head_plus_limited_body_decoder.risk: overfit and damage general pose robustness
B_output_head_plus_limited_body_decoder.minimum_ab: freeze all else and unfreeze only the last body-decoder block against option A
B_output_head_plus_limited_body_decoder.execute_when: only if A underfits training and validation together after labels are valid

C_adapter_or_lora.current_evidence: no evidence that feature adaptation is the current bottleneck
C_adapter_or_lora.required_supervision: more target-domain subjects than the minimum output-head pilot
C_adapter_or_lora.risk: correlated small data can overfit despite few trainable parameters
C_adapter_or_lora.minimum_ab: A versus same insertion points with fixed LoRA rank/seed/budget
C_adapter_or_lora.execute_when: after output-head pilot shows repeatable surface signal but limited capacity

D_per_image_parameter_refinement.solves: fit one observed person/image using masks, depth or multi-view evidence
D_per_image_parameter_refinement.current_evidence: prototype shows one training image contour can be fitted, partly through camera; no generalization proof
D_per_image_parameter_refinement.required_supervision: per-image calibrated depth/multiview or trusted mask with occlusion labels
D_per_image_parameter_refinement.risk: local fit, camera/shape cheating, latency; cannot stand in for global fine-tuning
D_per_image_parameter_refinement.minimum_ab: hold out some observed pixels/views for the same subject and check 3D/depth plus camera priors
D_per_image_parameter_refinement.execute_when: useful as a robot-time engineering module once sensor evidence exists, in parallel with global-model research
